body.text: Legacy estate-compiler retirement is complete. The disabled launch artifact and remaining implementation were removed behind two full-manifest DeletionProofs. A machine-readable RepositoryShape-owned fence preserves the frozen V8.1 prohibition and rejects any successor lacking a dedicated current EstateCompiler architecture, explicit owner, non-append-only state model, positive age/byte/count retention bounds, and non-authoritative projections. The launch label remains persistently disabled.

subject: Legacy estate compiler fully retired behind executable V8.1 fence
